Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
Neferiti plays Forced Awakening so she can block a younger vampire,
then plays Obedience.

Is the action considered successfully blocked? That is, does Neferiti
have to burn a blood for the FA? Can she play Extortion after
Obedience?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. No. Yes.
